assessments.reasoning: Receipts 03d5f485d6f7490fb5d1b4dc1be2f628 and 5d796bc21cf449d281ada2a31bd29aa4 cover the application paragraph, its complete example and subsequent recommendations in the claimed edition.

challenge.method: Compared the imperative with the example across the partition boundary, the preamble's “small modifications” wording for non-TeX works, the license-document notice and clause 11.
challenge.results: The document names LaTeX3 Project as its copyright holder and expressly prohibits modifying the license document. The preamble addresses a holder licensing their own work. Clause 11 leaves unrelated works and aggregation unrestricted by this license. A verbatim license file alone supplies neither the component notices nor authority over unrelated software.

limitations: The example's 1.3-or-later election, three files, maintenance status and named maintainer are hypothetical. Authority over a particular work depends on its holder.
reasoning: The 1.3a application paragraph says to place an explicit copyright notice in each component, giving the name and year the work was authored and/or last substantially modified. “Include also” introduces the component-specific statement about distribution and/or modification.
